# SkillFocus

**Tags:** `world-system`

Dedication: XP in a skill is multiplied by 1 + maxBonus x (active minutes in the last focus window) / window, counted in play time. A skill with no focus earns the normal rate.

> **Goal:** Reward a player for sticking with one skill without ever punishing trying another (Phase 272)

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `focusWindowMinutes` | integer | yes | Minutes of play time the focus looks back over |
| `maxBonus` | decimal | yes | XP bonus (0.25 = +25%) with a full window of activity in one skill |
